channel.title: Lynn Group Media - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Lynn Group Media (hoganstand.com)

item.title: Moran hails 'big win' over Galway
item.description: On a cold January's day in Salthill, Andy Moran warmly welcomed Mayo's first win over Galway in five attempts.

item.title: Team-work pleases new Cork hurling boss
item.description: Ben O'Connor cut a contented figure after his new Cork charges opened their Allianz Hurling League defence with a rousing 3-25 to 1-17 victory over Waterford at SuperValu Páirc Uí Chaoimh.

item.title: 'Technically, it was the correct call'
item.description: Eamonn Fitzmaurice believes Kerry's contentious buzzer-beating winner against Roscommon was the right call.

item.title: Sigerson and Fitzgibbon Cup finals to be played in Croke Park
item.description: The GAA Higher Education committee has announced that the finals of the Sigerson and Fitzgibbon Cups will return to Croke Park for the first time in 40 years this February.

item.title: RTÉ highlights show to keep Allianz in title
item.description: RTÉ's National League highlights programme will continue to be called Allianz League Sunday.

item.title: 'Game of two halves' leaves Brennan with plenty to ponder
item.description: Ger Brennan admits Dublin have a lot of improving to do ahead of this weekend's trip to Castlebar to face Mayo.

item.title: No excuses from Bannigan
item.description: Gabriel Bannigan is refusing to use Monaghan's long list of absentees as an excuse for their heavy Allianz Football League opener round defeat to Armagh.

item.title: Two-pointers flow as new ladies football rules take effect
item.description: There were four two-pointers recorded as the new playing rules took effect in the first round of the Lidl Ladies National Football League last weekend.

item.title: Canavan: write Meath off at your peril
item.description: Peter Canavan believes Meath are well on their way to building on last year's surprise run to the All-Ireland SFC semi-finals.

item.title: 'Richie Reid was harshly done by'
item.description: Henry Shefflin has questioned Derek Lyng's decision to leave Richie Reid out of his Kilkenny starting line-up against Offaly.
